insiemi.comando: python .programmi/K-ruoli-direzione/tools/q.py "select viewname, definition from pg_views where schemaname='sys' and definition ilike '%sys_auth_roles%'"
insiemi.output_grezzo:
viewname,definition
v_whistleblowing_fuori_dal_custode," SELECT r.auth_role_code AS ruolo_estraneo,
    r.auth_role_category AS famiglia_del_ruolo,
    p.auth_permission_code AS permesso,
    ( SELECT count(DISTINCT ur.user_auth_role_user_id) AS count
           FROM sys.sys_user_auth_roles ur
          WHERE ((ur.user_auth_role_role_id = r.auth_role_id) AND (ur.user_auth_role_revoked_at IS NULL))) AS persone_che_lo_portano
   FROM ((sys.sys_auth_role_permissions rp
     JOIN sys.sys_auth_roles r ON ((r.auth_role_id = rp.auth_role_id)))
     JOIN sys.sys_auth_permissions p ON ((p.auth_permission_id = rp.auth_permission_id)))
  WHERE (((p.auth_permission_code)::text ~~ 'whistleblowing:%'::text) AND ((r.auth_role_code)::text <> 'WHISTLEBLOWING_CUSTODIAN'::text));"
